purpose: What each classified field's appearance MEANS, so the finalizer can decide what it may contribute without branching on the family, the form, the field name or the text.

dispositions.preserve_source_appearance: official or source-inherent text the court put on its own form. It is carried onto the filing unchanged. Storage location does not decide this: official text lives in a widget appearance XObject on these forms just as a placeholder does.
dispositions.render_participant_value_only_when_writt: a participant input. Its appearance renders only when this run actually wrote a value for it; unwritten, it contributes nothing, so the source placeholder or default never reaches the filing.
dispositions.suppress_control_appearance: chrome for a person at a screen - a pushbutton and anything else that is a control rather than content. It never contributes to a finalized artifact.

defaultWhenUnclassified: preserve_source_appearance for anything that is not structurally a control or an unanswered chooser. Being wrong towards preservation leaves the court's own text on the filing; being wrong the other way removes it.
notAHeuristic: no entry here is derived from RichText, Multiline, a /Ff bit combination, ReadOnly, or whether the text sits in page content or a widget XObject. Each was measured at the snapshot above by reading the drawn appearance and matching it to its field by widget rectangle.

CA:ca-851-91-set:cr-409.whyThisFamilyNeededClassifying: CR-409's AcroForm /Fields array holds a single root and every terminal field hangs beneath it, so the finalizer's flat detachment never reached the five pushbuttons it had already classified as chrome. Once FIX06 made the detachment walk the field tree, all five were correctly removed - and that removed one whose caption is not chrome at all. The structural rule cannot tell them apart, which is exactly what this registry is for.
CA:ca-851-91-set:cr-409.howMeasured: Each caption was read from its widget's /MK /CA in data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1/ca/ca-851-91-set--official-pdf-fill/derived-sources/cr-409-pikepdf-unlocked.pdf, matched to its own /Rect, and compared against the surrounding page-content word boxes extracted with pdftotext -bbox.

CR-409[0].Page2[0].LI3-2[0].li3h[0].#fie.because: This is structurally a pushbutton, and it is not chrome. Its caption supplies the form number inside a sentence the court printed on the page: the page content stream draws 'should be submitted on the Attached Declaration (form' ending at x 322.581 and ').' beginning at x 360.740, and this widget's caption fills the gap between them. Suppressing it leaves the filed document reading '(form ).', which loses the court's own cross-reference to Judicial Council form MC-031 - a form this very packet delivers as a component. Being wrong towards preservation leaves the court's text on the filing; being wrong the other way removes it.
CR-409[0].Page2[0].LI3-2[0].li3h[0].#fie.theOverlapItCarriesIsTheSourcesOwn: 'MC-031' and ').' share 16.17 square points on the unmodified pikepdf-unlocked source and 23.90 on the delivered page. That pair is a property of the official form, not of this build, and preserving the caption preserves it rather than introducing it.

rcap-tx-custom-pleading:tx-expunction-fe.whyThisFamilyNeededClassifying: The Texas Statement of Inability to Afford Payment of Court Costs (Misc. Docket No. 22-9090) ships with three of its own AcroForm values already set: /V "0" on "Value / Valor 11" (page 7), /V "0" on "Amount Cantidad 15" (page 8), and /V "12/15/2022" on "Today", the date line of the Option 1 sworn declaration on page 11. All three are /Tx text fields, so the structural rule calls every one of them the court's own ink and preserves it. It is not the court's ink: each is a participant input, and the one on the declaration date line is delivered on a document sworn under penalty of perjury, beside a signature rule the packet leaves blank.
rcap-tx-custom-pleading:tx-expunction-fe.howMeasured: Retaken first-hand by this lane at the commit above, not copied from a sibling entry. Each /V, each widget /Rect and each annotation flag was read from the pinned source at private/human-source-returns/TX/TX__STATEMENTOFINABILITYTOAFFORDPAYMENTOFCOURTCOSTSO.pdf (sha256 bd17a3fe43d6989d1828c91c9a46c873908c272d8e2e342af35ce8bdb2fab10d, 6667524 bytes, 12 pages, 132 fields, 141 widgets) on source pages 7, 8 and 11. Exactly three of the 132 fields carry a non-empty /V and these are they; every other field ships empty. All three widgets carry /F 4 - Print set, Hidden (bit 2) and NoView (bit 6) both clear - and each carries an /AP with an /N stream, so none is suppressed by the annotation flags and each really does draw. The delivered appearances were then read back from fixtures/canonical.pdf and fixtures/boundary.pdf with flattenedWidgets() from scripts/rcap-official-forms/pdf-flattened-widgets.mjs, which is the only reader that settles this: pdftotext returns a clean reading of these pages because the glyphs are drawn with an unsubsetted /Arial it cannot map. Value / Valor 11 drew at packet page 7 (313.44, 131.32) as FlatWidget-1812800957 and Amount Cantidad 15 at packet page 8 (318.22, 91.2) as FlatWidget-4855138939, each landing on its own source /Rect lower-left corner.
rcap-tx-custom-pleading:tx-expunction-fe.theTwoFinancialZerosAreNowClassifiedToo: This entry originally classified Today alone and recorded in terms that the two page-7 and page-8 zeros were a separate question, deliberately not answered. This lane answered it, and the answer is that they are the same kind of thing as Today: a participant input the source ships pre-answered, which this build never writes and which the structural rule preserved anyway. Nothing about them was inherited from a sibling - the rectangles and flags above were re-measured from the pinned binary, and they agree with the four sibling families that enclose this same form because it is the same binary, not because the numbers were copied across.

Value / Valor 11.because: This family's own production-field-map.json refuses this field with completenessDisposition REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING and requiredBeforeFiling true, for the stated reason "the platform holds no financial fact about any participant, and a guessed figure on a sworn affidavit is a worse defect than a blank one", and it tells the participant to supply "the entry and the amount, from your own records - this is sworn under penalty of perjury". So this build never writes the field, and the only way a value reaches the page is the /V "0" the official source ships, which the structural rule read as the court's own ink and flattened. It is not the court's ink and it is not a confirmed answer: the zero is present in the blank issuer-original form before any participant sees it. A zero on a sworn statement of inability to pay is an answer the participant never gave, on the line where the value of a listed item of property is sworn.

Today.because: This is the date part of the Option 1 declaration - "I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct" - directly above the preprinted label "Date (month, day, year) / Fecha (mes, dia, ano)" and below an empty Signature rule. This family's own production-field-map.json refuses it with category signature_or_date_participant_completion and the reason "signature or date field; never prefilled by this build", reports/blanks-left-for-the-participant.json carries it among protectedBlanks, and participant-instructions.md tells the participant "Your signature and the date" are among the things deliberately left blank because "You sign when you actually swear it." A date the participant did not enter, four years stale, on a perjury declaration, is ink no packet may carry, and the packet states in terms that it is not there.
